title: Response sites of the Bhote Koshi / Trishuli flood — hand-verified ledger
note: Every site names the document it was read from. Coordinates: 'published' = the named facility located on OpenStreetMap; 'place' = the named locality located on OpenStreetMap, the exact plot not published; 'municipality' = the municipality centre, because the report names only the municipality and ward; 'approximate' = desk placement from the description. Figures are the reporting outlet's, dated.

notes.text: Prithvi Highway remains cut at Krishnabhir; access is the binding constraint on the response. A new track above Krishnabhir is being opened; an alternative road opened at Parewabhir.

notes.text: Foreign relief flights land here: Indian Air Force (fifth flight, 5.5 t medicines and an 11-member team), PLA Air Force Y-20 (second batch, DNA experts, drones), ROKAF KC-330 (44-member team, 5 search dogs), UAE relief aircraft (second).
